Legacy points earned +2 New ground cash $40 Reputation multiplier x1.00 to x1.50 This ground resets Current cash becomes $40. This ground's earnings reset to 0. Fans return to 90. Ground upgrades and staff start at level 0. You restart in Muddy Meadows League. The current match, table, win streak and temporary boosts reset. Ticket offer returns to Standard. You keep Your club name, reputation, legacy points and perks, badges, league titles and career records. Your Academy players, first team, gems and gear stay as they are. Back ? Sell and restart Close

Sell up review Restart this ground with permanent rewards. The match keeps running while you decide. Selling up trades this ground's progress for one reputation star and legacy points. Your reputation multiplier is permanent, but today's income also depends on the ground, crowd and staff you are resetting. Example: selling now adds 2 legacy points, taking your balance from 0 to 2. Your new ground opens with $40. Rolling Investment is already included. These terms follow the live game. A promotion while this is open can increase the legacy points. Back leaves the sale untouched. Only Sell and restart sells the ground. Back to sale review ? Close
